The HWPX inventory report generation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, confirming the core document processing logic is functional.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the single pytest case in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. While the judge_reward of 0.78 suggests minor stylistic or efficiency improvements are possible, the underlying HWPX parsing and reporting mechanism is stable. Future iterations should verify handling of edge-case HWPX schemas to ensure the current success isn't limited to the specific test document.
